1.body:
Hello,

I saw your opening for a UI/UX Designer fresher at Zunderdog and was drawn to your focus on building screens in close collaboration with developers.

During my time at AT Creation, I built wireframes, user flows, and handled developer handoff for various startup clients. I also use Figma daily to ensure layouts remain consistent with brand systems.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates how I structured a clean verification experience for teams, which you can review directly in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am currently based in Nagpur and am completely ready to relocate to Pune. Would you be open to a quick 15-minute call to discuss my wireframing and handoff process?

Ananya
